# Sign in with a key

You got the key when you paid. No email needed.

With email

With a key

Licence key

The key is the only way into such an account. Lose it and access cannot be recovered: we have no email to send anything to.

[Sign in]

Where is my key? Not in an email — it is shown after payment, and in the app: Settings → Account.

## What the account holds

- Your subscription and invoices
- Your Macs: how many, and when they were last online
- Encrypted sync blocks — only you can read them

The master password of your profiles is never entered here. It never leaves your Mac — not even to sign in.
